id: validation-Deployment Synchronization with Instance-Invariant Storage Code-case-6

pointer.content:
Test Case 6: OpenCode Version in Container (Optional)

Input: Check opencode version inside running pod

Expected Output:
{
  "versionCheckSuccessful": true,
  "version": "1.0.64"
}

Validation Logic:
- Get pod name: kubectl get pods -n devbob -l app.kubernetes.io/name=devbob
- Exec into pod: kubectl exec -n devbob <pod> -- opencode --version
- Parse version number from output
- Compare against expected version 1.0.64

Pass Criteria:
- Can exec into pod successfully
- opencode --version runs without error
- Version matches 1.0.64

Note: Test may fail if pod is CrashLoopBackOff due to config (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY missing). This is acceptable - primary validation is image tag correctness.
